notes.title: 🛠️ Cursebound 0.31 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers!

I've just shipped a fresh update packed with quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and some requested features. Here's what's new:

🎮 Full Gamepad Support

 The entire game is now fully playable with a gamepad - from menus to combat. 

🖱️ Camera Sensitivity Settings

 You can now adjust both mouse and gamepad camera sensitivity in the options menu. Tune your aim and comfort to your liking.


⚔️ Combat & Controls

 Auto Attack: Holding the Quick Attack button now triggers continuous strikes.
 Rotate While Aiming: You can now rotate the camera while aiming your bow.


📺 UI & Visuals

 Blur While in Menus: Background blur added to menus for a more focused and immersive experience.
 Blur Persistence Fix: Fixed an issue where blur would stay active when returning from the main menu to the game.


 🛡️ Gameplay Fixes

 No Damage During Menus: You’re now invulnerable while navigating menus. No more dying while adjusting settings.


I hope this patch smooths out your journey and enhances your experience. Thanks for all the feedback! Keep it coming ♥

- nuuunu
